items.title: Higher Order Sigma Rules (HOSR): Turning Sigma Alerts into ATT&CK-Mapped Attack Chains
items.summary: Higher Order Sigma Rules (HOSR) are correlation rules that sit one level above standard Sigma detections. Instead of matching a single log event, a Higher Order Sigma rule links the Sigma rules that fire on one host into an attack chain mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Most SOC teams already run hundreds of Sigma rules. Each flags one suspicious step, such as an encoded PowerShell command or a new service install, but analysts still have to work out which alerts belong to the same intrusion.
